start.intro: Chess bots compete against each other here. All games are public.
start.noRunning: No game is running right now.

ratings.title: Ranking
ratings.hint: Bots and players with at least one rated game. Every bot version and every account starts at 2500.
ratings.name: Name

bot.verifying: The bot is being verified. This page updates itself.
bot.truncated: There were more findings than listed.
bot.deleteWarning: This version is deleted with its files, its verification report and all its games; the ratings are counted again afterwards. This cannot be undone.
bot.descriptionHint: Plain text, at most {{max}} characters. Everyone can read it.
bot.retireHint: A withdrawn bot plays no new games; its games stay.
bot.retiredHint: The bot is withdrawn and plays no new games.
bot.recheckPending: A recheck is waiting or running. This page updates itself.
bot.overrideWarning: The bot then counts as verified and may play although the verification rejected it. The reason for the rejection stays visible.

upload.title: Upload a bot
upload.intro: Choose the folder of your bot, for example a copy of the Python template. Only .py files and files directly in data/ (for load_data) are uploaded; everything else stays on your computer.
upload.name: Name
upload.nameHint: 3 to 32 characters: letters, digits, _ . or -. The name of one of your bots makes a new version of it.
upload.versionHint: X.Y.Z, higher than every earlier version of the name.
upload.noFiles: Choose a folder or files with at least one .py file.
upload.tooManyFiles: At most 100 .py files and 100 data files are allowed.
upload.tooLarge: The .py files and the data files may each be at most 1 MB in all.
upload.noEntry: The top folder needs a .py file the bot starts with.
upload.review: The bot is checked and tested before it may play.

ownBots.title: My bots
ownBots.empty: You have not uploaded a bot yet.
ownBots.noVerified: Once one of your bots is verified, you can schedule games for it here.
ownBots.limits: Free times at most {{initialSeconds}} seconds plus {{incrementSeconds}} seconds a move; disciplines without this limit. At most {{games}} games at once and {{gamesPerDay}} games a day. Your games start after those set by admins.

ownMatchError.initial_time_ms: The time must be between 1 and {{initialSeconds}} seconds.
ownMatchError.increment_ms: The increment may be at most {{incrementSeconds}} seconds.
ownMatchError.white_bot_id: One of the bots must be yours, and both must be verified.
ownMatchError.black_bot_id: The opponent must be a verified bot.

disciplines.title: Disciplines
disciplines.editHint: Changes apply to games scheduled afterwards.
disciplines.name: Name
disciplines.nameTaken: Another discipline already has this name.
disciplines.ratedHint: Only games under a discipline from the standard position are rated.

disciplineError.name: The name must have 1 to 40 characters without control characters.
disciplineError.startup_ms: The startup time must be between 1 and 60 seconds.
disciplineError.tolerance_ms: The tolerance must be between 0 and 1000 ms.

queue.title: Queue
queue.paused: The queue is paused; no new games start.
queue.noRunning: No game is running right now.
queue.estimateNote: Times are estimated from the duration of earlier games with the same time control.

viewer.keyboard: Keyboard: ← → step, Home/End jump, Space plays.

fieldError.username: The name does not follow the rules.
fieldError.password: The password must have 10 to 128 characters.
fieldError.new_password: The new password must have 10 to 128 characters.
fieldError.initial_time_ms: The time must be between 1 second and 24 hours.

fieldError.priority: The priority must be between 0 and 1000.
fieldError.max_moves: The move limit must be between 1 and 2000.

fieldError.black_bot_id: Black is not a verified bot.
fieldError.valid_days: A link is valid for 1 to {{max}} days.

fieldError.status: The bot cannot switch to this status.
fieldError.description: The description may have at most 500 characters and no control characters except line breaks.
fieldError.discipline_id: The discipline is unknown or archived.

login.title: Log in
login.inviteOnly: Accounts are by invitation only. Watching needs no account.

account.title: Account
account.usernameRule: 3 to 32 characters: letters, digits, _ . or -, starting with a letter or digit.
account.passwordChanged: The password is changed. Other logins have ended.
account.ratingHint: Your games against bots under a discipline from the standard position are rated. After the first rated game, your name and rating appear in the public ranking. Like all games, yours are public.

invite.title: Accept invitation
invite.intro: Choose a name and a password for your account.

reset.title: New password
reset.intro: Choose a new password. All existing logins will end.

oneTimeLink.note: The link is shown only now and works once, until {{expires}}.

admin.title: Admin
admin.resetLinkFor: Link for a new password of {{username}}
admin.recheckHint: Checks all verified and rejected uploaded bots of a language with the current rules. Each recheck only adds a report; the status stays.

play.title: Play against a bot
play.intro: Choose a bot and a time control. You play in the browser; the server checks every move. Like all games, the game is public; as a guest you appear as “Guest”.
play.noBots: There is no verified bot to play against yet.
play.limits: One game at a time, at most 50 a day; free times up to 30 min + 30 s.
play.noSeat: This game was started in another browser or its seat was lost.

phase.waiting: Waiting for the bot to start …
phase.refused: This game cannot be joined (any more).
phase.ended: The game was ended without a result.

problem.replaced: The game was opened in another window.
problem.no_game: The game is no longer waiting for you.
problem.other: Something went wrong; please try again.

play.ratedHint: Logged in and under a discipline, the game counts for your rating (account page and ranking); as a guest or with free times it is unrated.

playError.increment_ms: The increment may be at most 30 seconds.

adminPlay.intro: Limits of games against people and remote bots. Games at once and per day count for each address, account and API token on its own.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.intro: With a token your bot plays on your machine against bots on the server: python bot.py --remote URL --opponent NAME, with the token in SBM_TOKEN. Such games are not rated but public.
tokens.onlyOnce: Copy it now: it is shown only this once.
tokens.name: Name

tokenError.name: 1 to 40 characters; an account has at most 10 tokens.

adminSettings.codersHint: Apply to uploads and to games coders set for their own bots. Games set by admins have priority 100.
adminSettings.accountsHint: Validity of new invite links in days and wrong passwords in a row after which a login is locked for 15 minutes.
adminSettings.ratingHint: Start value and rule for gains and draws. A change counts all rated games again.
adminSettings.estimateHint: Basis for the estimated start of waiting games.
adminSettings.recountPending: The ratings are being counted again.

settingsError.invite_days: The default validity must not exceed the longest.
settingsError.min_win: The smallest gain must not exceed the gain at equal rating.
settingsError.max_win: The largest gain must not be below the gain at equal rating.
